vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 20s sets out to find A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A man, maybe 40s, with restless hands about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A man, maybe 50s, with thick glasses about Roberto. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Quiet birds. I'll add it to the list of things that mean something."
🚶 A man, maybe 20s is back — found A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Paisley, Gunther, Antônio and David met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Paisley, Gunther, David are hurt.
🛡️ Paisley, Gunther, Pablo and David met them at the door — 4 put down. Paisley, Gunther, Pablo, David are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Gunther, Antônio, Pablo, Thabo and Mateo met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Gunther, Antônio, Pablo, Thabo, Mateo are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Raj — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Raj chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Felix just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Felix and Zhanibek met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Felix, Zhanibek are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
